info.name: The genuinely dark moonless observing window of a night: astronomical night intersected with the Moon being down, ranked across up to 62 nights with a trend

params.name: at
params.description: The instant to evaluate. ISO 8601: a date (2026-06-21), or a date and time with an optional seconds, fraction and either Z or a numeric UTC offset. No offset and no `tz` reads as UTC. Reliable from 1700 to 2200.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, north positive. No compass suffix (do not append N or S). Required together with lon, or neither.

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, east positive. No compass suffix (do not append E or W). Required together with lat, or neither.

params.name: elevation_m
params.description: Observer elevation above mean sea level, in metres. Raises the observer on a locally flat plateau; sea-horizon dip is not modelled.

params.name: place
params.description: A place name (place=London), a name with a country (place=Cambridge,GB), or a stable identifier from GET /v2/places (place=id:us-n35198-w111651). Supplies lat, lon and, unless tz is also sent, the time zone. Mutually exclusive with sending lat and lon directly. Withheld unless GET /v2 reports capabilities.place_lookup true.

params.name: place_strategy
params.description: best guesses the intended place when a name is ambiguous and reports the guess as a warning. error refuses an ambiguous name with 400 AMBIGUOUS_PLACE and the candidates in `supported`. Only meaningful with `place`.

params.name: nights
params.description: How many consecutive local nights to rank, starting the night `at` falls in.

params.name: sun_depression_deg
params.description: The solar depression angle, in degrees, that defines "dark" for this request. Default 18 (astronomical night).

params.name: moon_altitude_max_deg
params.description: The Moon must be at or below this altitude, in degrees, to count as "down". Default 0.

params.name: moon_illumination_max
params.description: Treat the Moon as "down" whenever its illuminated fraction is at or below this value, whatever its altitude. Default 1 (illumination never overrides altitude).

params.name: tz
params.description: An IANA time zone name, for example Europe/London or America/Chicago. Numeric offsets and abbreviations are not accepted. Governs how a date-only or offset-free `at`/`start`/`end` is read, and how local instants are rendered when time_format=iso.

params.name: ambiguous
params.description: How to resolve a local time that a clock repeated, such as the return from daylight saving. error refuses with 409 AMBIGUOUS_LOCAL_TIME.

params.name: nonexistent
params.description: How to resolve a local time that never happened, such as inside a spring-forward gap. error refuses with 400 NONEXISTENT_LOCAL_TIME.

params.name: time_format
params.description: How instants are rendered: iso for ISO 8601 strings carrying the effective offset, or unix for integer seconds since the epoch.

params.name: format
params.description: Response representation. Each endpoint serves a subset of json, csv and txt; see that operation's description for the exact list, or GET /v2 for every endpoint's formats array. An unsupported value is 400 BAD_FORMAT with the accepted list in `supported`.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated dot paths into `data` (for example moon.phase_name,moon.illumination) so only those fields are returned. Up to 64 paths; an array element is addressed by its object key, never by index.

params.name: shape
params.description: nested returns the documented object tree. flat returns one object with dotted keys, format=json only.

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal places for numeric fields.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Whether the JSON body is indented (1) or compact (0). Has no effect on csv or txt.

params.name: verbosity
params.description: full includes prose notes, frame definitions and withheld-field reasons in meta. compact keeps every value and every machine-readable name and drops the prose.

items.docs: The genuinely dark moonless observing window of a night: astronomical night intersected with the Moon being down, ranked across up to 62 nights with a trend. Formats: json, csv. Example: GET /v2/dark-window?lat=51.509&lon=-0.126&at=2026-11-14&tz=Europe/London&nights=3
